transfer_summary.note: transfer entries are summarised over the directions and in-domain entries over the sources; n_directions_* counts compare each direction's transfer value with its own source's in-domain value

diversity.basis: Q and error_corr measure how dependent the learners' errors are; disagreement and the contested share also rise when accuracy falls (see disagreement_implied_by_accuracy)

dependence.note: directions of one source share its fold models; directions whose targets are the same posts share the target instances; EV-Norm and EV-Raw are the same 1,382 posts in two renderings

reliability.note: agreement between first-pass and non-blind adjudicated labels; likely an upper bound on independent agreement

auroc_revision.note: CIs resample posts and condition on the trained ensemble; the ambiguity score uses the adjudicated label

confident_learning.note: the issue rate estimates residual noise in the final labels, not the revision rate

auroc_revision.note: CIs resample posts and condition on the trained ensemble; the ambiguity score uses the adjudicated label

confident_learning.note: the issue rate estimates residual noise in the final labels, not the revision rate

cost.headline_statistic: medians over runs; means and SDs are inflated by contention on the shared machine (gpu_cost.contention) and their keys (*_mean*) are kept for reference only

wallclock_hours_from_file_times.imputation: a seed without a complete set of posterior files counts as the median of the measured seeds 1-4

gpu_hours_all_runs_estimate.note: headline: gpu_hours_from_medians and wallclock_hours_from_file_times (measured per seed; seeds 1-4 include the revision's transfer scoring, seed 42 does not). wallclock_hours_from_means applies the seeds 1-4 end-to-end/GPU ratio, which transfer scoring dominates, to all runs including seed 42; reference only

wallclock_hours_all_runs.imputation: a seed without a complete set of posterior files counts as the median of the measured seeds 1-4

wallclock_hours_from_file_times.method: per seed, gaps between consecutive posterior files, gaps > 5x the seed's median gap excluded as downtime, uncovered runs counted with their log total= (else the mean kept gap)

notes: posterior_file_span_hours_per_seed is the raw first-to-last file span (runs 2..n, including downtime); cite wallclock_hours_per_seed, which excludes downtime_excluded_hours_per_seed

the B*_pct keys are shares; changes_vs_B5000 gives counts with their denominators: fold fits = folds x bootstrap seeds, predictions = fits x test posts, production stream = replicate 0 (behind the reported results)
end-to-end wall-clock includes transfer scoring (transfer_posts_per_run_per_seed), which seeds 1-4 did for 3-4 corpora and seed 42 only from EV-Norm to EV-Public
CPU timings are in citable_cpu_timing (wall-clock, not deterministic)

fusion_overhead.wording: fusing with SA-WSV costs about 0.3 us per post, about 0.01% of the ensemble's forward passes
fusion_overhead.basis: median single-thread CPU time of the fitted rule applied to a fold's test posteriors, against the five learners' GPU forward passes (bf16, batch 64, throughput); not an increment over uniform soft voting, which is given separately

cost_timing.note: cite the *_best_of_reps_by_n_val values, rounded: single-thread timings on a shared machine reproduce only to tens of percent; the B = 1000 grid entry and the isolated SA-WSV (bootstrap) fit are one measurement; fit time is linear in B
